stem: Which sentence best states the main idea of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: All this information was available because of the microchip that had been placed under Scrub’s skin many years earlier.

options.label: B
options.text: Microchips have helped thousands of owners get their lost pets back.

options.label: C
options.text: However, thanks to her microchip, Roxy was soon returned to her grateful owner.

options.label: D
options.text: However, tags and collars can fall off or become difficult to read.
